title: Health Charted Prenatal Profile
description: Pregnancy-specific profile data: gestational age, phase, conception and due dates, gravidity, parity, prior pregnancy outcomes, dietary pattern relevant to prenatal nutrition, genetic variants relevant to prenatal supplementation, and breastfeeding state.

current_phase.description: Current submodule phase. Derive from gestational_age_weeks for active pregnancies; set explicitly for postpartum/lactation.

phase_set_date.description: ISO date when current_phase was last updated. Used for phase-transition detection.

conception_date.description: Estimated or known conception date (ISO). Used to compute gestational_age_weeks.

lmp_date.description: Last menstrual period start date (ISO). Alternate gestational age basis when conception date is unknown.

due_date.description: Estimated due date (ISO), 40 weeks from LMP or 38 weeks from conception. May be adjusted by ultrasound.

gestational_age_weeks.description: Computed weekly. Used to derive current_phase for active pregnancies and to surface biological-window proximity.

parity.description: Number of pregnancies carried to viability.

prior_pregnancy_outcomes.description: History of prior pregnancies. May affect current pregnancy risk stratification and supplementation priorities.

outcome.description: live birth, miscarriage, stillbirth, ectopic, termination, etc.

dietary_pattern.description: omnivore, pescatarian, vegetarian, vegan, etc. Affects nutrient adequacy assessment (B12, iron, choline, omega-3, etc.).

genetic_variants.description: Variants relevant to prenatal supplementation (folate metabolism, methylation, etc.).

source.description: Test or report source if known

breastfeeding.description: Breastfeeding state when current_phase is lactation or recent postpartum.

phase_transition_log.description: Append-only history of phase transitions. Useful for trajectory analysis and reassessment cadence.

trigger.description: What prompted the transition (gestational age threshold, birth, weaning, etc.)

notes.description: Free-text notes the user wants captured at the profile level.
